hero.title: Moddy, the only bot you need.
hero.text: AI-powered moderation, social notifications, welcome messages and everyday utilities for your Discord server, all in one bot.
hero.feedLabel: Example of what Moddy does in a server

automod.title: Moderation that never sleeps
automod.text: AutoMod AI reads the room. It spots harmful messages in real time and warns, mutes or bans before the damage is done, with no rules to fine-tune by hand.
automod.author: troublemaker · today at 21:04
automod.message: Free nitro for everyone, click this link now!!
automod.detail: Scam link detected by AutoMod AI, case A7F2K9 opened

cases.title: Every sanction, on the record
cases.text: Each warn, mute or ban becomes a case with its own reference code, a full timeline and built-in appeals.

social.title: Your creators, in your server
social.text: Post an update the moment a YouTube channel uploads, a Twitch streamer goes live, a Bluesky account posts or an RSS feed publishes.

modules.title: One bot, every module
modules.text: Turn on only what your server needs, and configure each module in a couple of clicks. From welcome messages to tickets, Moddy grows with your community.
modules.label: Some of Moddy's modules

logs.title: Nothing slips by
logs.text: Server logs post a clear entry seconds after anything happens: an edited message, a new role, a ban, a permission change.
logs.label: events watched, none filtered by guesswork

tickets.title: A real support desk
tickets.text: Members open a private ticket with a button or a dropdown. You decide where each request goes, which roles can see it and who claims it.

utilities.title: Handy tools, everywhere
utilities.text: Translate, set reminders, fix or summarize text, roll dice. Most commands work anywhere, even in your DMs.
utilities.label: Some of Moddy's commands

altguard.title: Alt accounts stay out
altguard.text: AltGuard checks new members as they join and acts on suspected alternate accounts, so a ban really means gone for good.
altguard.suspected: Suspected alt of a banned member

dashboard.title: Configure from your browser
dashboard.text: Enable modules, review cases and customize the bot from the web dashboard, no command to remember.

max.title: Go further with Moddy Max
max.text: Moderation, AutoMod AI and welcome messages are free on every server. Moddy Max adds a few extras on the servers you care about most.

servers.title: 5 premium servers
servers.detail: Pick them from your dashboard and switch at any time.

customization.title: Full bot customization
customization.detail: Nickname, avatar, banner and bio that match your community.

notifications.title: Faster notifications
notifications.detail: Quicker polling and up to 5 accounts per platform.

final.title: Ready to meet Moddy?
final.text: Add it to your server in a few clicks and turn on your first module.
